To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On‑prem evaluation — next steps and MAP?

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the call yesterday. NimbusBank is very interested in a short on‑prem pilot tied to a mutual action plan so our security and procurement teams can run evaluations in parallel with your commercial review. High level asks from our side:

- Clear acceptance criteria for the pilot (security, perf, and cost targets)
- A proposed milestone schedule with commercial levers (credits, discounts, platform fee treatment) tied to acceptance gates
- A starter SOW and procurement path we can hand to our legal/procurement team

We have an internal deadline to present a recommendation to the exec committee the week of June 7. That gives us about 4 weeks to complete the pilot and close if results are positive. Can you share a MAP draft that ties milestones to a pricing/commit trajectory and platform fee treatment for a private/VPC deployment?

Cc'ing Lidia (ops) and procurement.

Thanks,
Carlos
Carlos Mendez
VP, Cloud Innovation — NimbusBank

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@nimbusbank.com>
Cc: Lidia Gomez <l.gomez@nimbusbank.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial close cadence and MAP crosswalk for NimbusBank on‑prem pilot

Carlos —

Appreciate the clarity on timelines. Attached is a working MAP spreadsheet (Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a starter SOW (SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf). High‑level proposal below; happy to iterate in a short call Monday.

Proposed MAP and commercial linkages (concise):

1) Pilot window (30 days):
- Scope: Private VPC package with customer‑managed network; 2 H100 equivalent serving slots + 1 load test slot for 72h.
- Acceptance criteria: SOC2 controls validated by our evidence bundle, <150ms p95 latency for the primary prompt set at 8k context, and accuracy on your eval set with <7% regression vs baseline.
- Commercial: Pilot credit of $35k applied to any future committed spend if we move to Reserve; otherwise pilot billed at usage rates.

2) Post‑pilot commitment (Target close within 14 days of pilot acceptance):
- Committed package: 4 dedicated GPU slots (H100 equivalent) with burst pool; committed monthly spend $120,000 (Year 1).
- Commitment discounts: 10% off published hosted rates on committed usage.
- Additional ramp discount: +5% applied retroactively once monthly usage exceeds 120% of commit for two consecutive months.

3) Platform fee (private / on‑prem):
- Proposal: $15,000/month base platform fee for private deployment (covers control plane, long‑term observability retention and private networking).
- Conditional adjustments: Waive first 2 months of platform fee if Nimbus converts to an annual committed contract within 45 days of pilot acceptance. Alternatively, reduce to $7,500/month for first 3 months if you sign a 6‑month commitment.

4) Pricing guardrails and floor/ceiling:
- If usage is below 60% of commit for 3 consecutive months, we will revisit the commit and allow a one‑time reduction (not to exceed 30% of original commit) after a joint review.

5) Security/compliance deliverables:
- Attached: SOC2 evidence bundle stub (SOC2_evidence_stub.zip) and a checklist. We will provide a secure link for on‑site evidence.

Next steps:
- Quick call Monday 10am PT to walk MAP rows and lock acceptance criteria?
- I will loop in pricing and legal with the SOW and markups once you confirm which commercial option you prefer (annual vs 6‑month commit).

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf, SOC2_evidence_stub.zip

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Team —

Looping you in on NimbusBank. They want a tight MAP tied to pilot acceptance and a clear platform fee concession for an early commitment. Key asks from procurement: pilot credit treatment, SOW redlines, and platform fee waiver window.

Quick bullet asks for internal alignment:
- Aditya: confirm H100‑equivalent sizing and expected monthly token throughput for the committed package so we can validate $120k/month is the right anchor.
- Stephanie: legal — can we offer the 2‑month platform fee waiver if they sign an annual? Any gotchas on the SOW redlines (liability/data residency clauses)?
- Marcus/Rishi: finance/pricing — confirm the discount stack (10% + ramp 5%) and whether we need to cap the retroactive discount exposure.

I plan to propose the 2‑month platform fee waiver as the default commercial path on the Monday call unless you advise otherwise.

Thanks,
Evelyn

Evelyn —

Thanks for the detailed MAP and the draft SOW. NimbusBank is comfortable with the proposed acceptance criteria and the pilot credit structure. We want to move forward with the 30‑day pilot starting the week of May 24. Procurement has two requests before we issue PO:

1) Confirm platform fee treatment in writing: we prefer the two‑month waiver tied to an annual commit. Please add that clause to the SOW and we will sign if pricing and liability language are acceptable.
2) Include a clear exit/scale clause: if we exercise the one‑time reduction (below 60% of commit), the reduction cannot take effect sooner than month 4 to avoid churn during initial stabilization.

If you can return a marked SOW with the platform fee waiver clause and the exit timing language by EOD May 21 we will circulate a PO for the pilot and aim to complete the pilot acceptance matrix by June 25 to meet our June 7 exec check (internal gating — this will be a baseline recommendation, final approval could slip by one week).

Cc'ing procurement and Lidia.

Best,
Carlos
